title: CShift project (cshift.json)
description: Project file for `cshiftc build` / `cshiftc run`. Only "name" is required.

name.description: Project name. Used for the default output file (bin/<name>) and as module name.

type.description: "executable" links a program, "object" only produces an object file.

sources.description: Source files or directories (searched recursively for *.csh), relative to this file. All files form one program.

output.description: Output path relative to this file, without extension (.exe is added on Windows). Default: bin/<name>.

unchecked.description: Integer overflow wraps around instead of ending the program with a panic (like --unchecked). Division by zero and index checks stay.

debug.description: Debug information (like -g): source lines and functions for gdb and lldb. Best with "optimize": 0.

backend.description: Code generator: "llvm" (LLVM IR, compiled and linked by clang) or "m68k" (CShift's own 68000 code generator, assembler and linker, like --backend). Default: m68k for AmigaOS targets (m68k-amigaos), llvm for all others.

ndk.description: The AmigaOS NDK folder (e.g. NDK3.2), relative to this file (like --ndk; the environment variable CSHIFT_NDK is used if this is not set). "using X from "lib.sfd";" finds the SFD files in <ndk>/SFD, and <ndk>/Include_H is searched for C headers on amigaos targets.

links.description: Libraries passed to the linker, in addition to 'link "name";' directives in the sources. A plain name is a library (-l<name>); an entry with a path or a file extension (.a .o .obj .lib .so .dylib .dll) is a file linked directly, relative to this file.

includePaths.description: Search paths for C headers (like -I), relative to this file. Used by 'using Name from "header.h";'.

defines.description: Macros defined while parsing C headers (like -D), e.g. "NAME" or "NAME=value".

ffiApi.description: Headers whose path contains one of these texts belong to the API of an imported C header even if they are system headers (for umbrella headers, e.g. "llvm-c/").

libraryPaths.description: Search paths for the linker (like -L), relative to this file.

target.description: Target triple, e.g. x86_64-w64-windows-gnu, i686-linux-gnu or m68k-amigaos (an Amiga program, built with the m68k backend). Default: the host.

platforms.description: Additions per platform, appended to the common lists when building for that platform.
